newsitem.title: FINLAND: DANISH UNIBANK SAYS MARKKA LIKELY TO WEAKEN.
newsitem.headline: DANISH UNIBANK SAYS MARKKA LIKELY TO WEAKEN.

text.p: Danish Unibank said in a weekly report received on Friday the Finnish markka was more likely to weaken than to strengthen against the German mark.
"We still judge a strengthening of the DEM/FIM cross more likely than not," Unibank said.
"The risk of further DEM/FIM weakening seems to be limited, while dollar weakening (against the mark) or speculation in the level for a Finnish ERM link could strengthen DEM/FIM," it said.
The bank said it expects the markka to be linked to Europe's exchange rate mechanism this year.
"It would be more favourable for the government to wait until after the local and EU elections on October 20," Unibank said.
The Finnish bond market looked attractive.

"Given the scarcity of domestic events in the week ahead, yields will be driven by international markets, while the positive EMU mood should continue to spill over to the spreads to Germany," it said.
"In our view, Finland is likely to continue to outperform Germany in the weeks ahead," Unibank said.
